speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with delayed menarche, unusual physical features, and a history of bone fragility. To begin our evaluation, have you noticed any short stature or a characteristic "shield-shaped" chest compared to your peers?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: 17-alpha-hydroxylase deficiency.

The history of partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth, combined with severe acne and delayed menarche, strongly suggests this condition. REQUEST TEST: Serum electrolytes, plasma renin activity, and aldosterone levels. REQUEST TEST: 17-hydroxyprogesterone and 11-deoxycorticosterone.
